source.text: ወ*ይከውን፡ በዝኩ፡ መዋዕል፡ ይወርዱ፡ ደቂቅ፡ *ኅሩያን፡ ወቅዱሳን፡ እም*ልዑል፡ ሰማይ፡ ወ*አሐደ፡ ይከውን፡ ዘርኦሙ፡ ምስለ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: In those days chosen and holy children[a] will descend from high heaven, and their offspring will become one with humankind.

footnotes.text: The printed Ge’ez retains the word “children.” The compressed wording may also be understood as “children of the chosen and holy ones.” Charles brackets the passage from 38:6 through the first part of 39:2 as an interpolation; it is retained here with that editorial judgment disclosed.

source.text: ወበውእቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ ነሥአ፡ ሄኖክ፡ መጻሕፍተ፡ *ቅንአት፡ ወመዐት፡ ወመጻሕፍተ፡ ጕጕአ፡ ወሀውክ፡] ወ*ምሕረት፡ ኢይከውን፡ ላዕሌሆሙ፡ ይቤ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: In those days Enoch received books of zeal and wrath, and books of tumult and confusion.[a] “Mercy will not be upon them,” says the Lord of Spirits.

footnotes.text: Charles’s interpolation bracket, opened at 38:6, closes here after the books of tumult and confusion. This is an editorial assessment of the passage, not a claim that it is absent from every manuscript. “Tumult” may also be rendered “disturbance” or “outcry.”

source.text: ወበውእቱ፡ መዋዕል፡ መሠጠኒ፡ ዐውሎ፡ ነፋሳት፡ እም*ገጸ፡ ለምድር፡ ወአንበረኒ፡ ውስተ፡ *ጽንፈ፡ ሰማያት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: In those days a whirlwind carried me away from the face of the earth and set me down at the farthest edge of the heavens.

source.text: ወበህየ፡ ርኢኩ፡ ራእየ፡ ካልአ፡ ማኅደሪሆሙ፡ ለቅዱሳን፡ ወምስካባቲሆሙ፡ ለጻድቃን።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: There I saw another vision: the dwelling places of the holy ones and the resting places of the righteous.

source.text: በህየ፡ ርእያ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ማኅደሮሙ፡ ምስለ፡ *መላእክተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወምስካቢሆሙ፡ ምስለ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ወይስእሉ፡ ወያስተበቍዑ፡ ወይጼልዩ፡ በእንተ፡ ውሉደ፡ ሰብእ፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ከመ፡ ማይ፡ ይውሕዝ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ፡ ወምሕረት፡ ከመ፡ ጠል፡ ውስተ፡ ምድር፡ ከመዝ፡ ውእቱ፡ ማእከሎሙ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: There my eyes saw their dwelling place with the angels of righteousness, and their resting place with the holy ones. They ask and plead and pray on behalf of humankind. Righteousness flows before them like water, and mercy like dew upon the earth. So it is among them forever and ever.

source.text: ወበውእቱ፡ መካን፡ ርእያ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ *ኅሩየ፡ ለጽድቅ፡ ወዘሃይማኖት፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ይከውን፡ በመዋዕሊሁ፡ ወጻድቃን፡ ወኅሩያን፡ ኍልቈ፡ አልቦሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: In that place my eyes saw the Chosen One of righteousness and faithfulness.[a] Righteousness will be in his days, and the righteous and chosen will be without number before him forever and ever.

footnotes.text: Charles prints the singular “Chosen One.” His apparatus records plural readings and readings with an added word for “dwelling place.” This translation follows the selected critical text, not unanimous manuscript testimony. “Faithfulness” may also be rendered “faith.”

source.text: ወርኢኩ፡ ማኅደረ፡ መትሕተ፡ *አክናፈ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ወ*ኵሉ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ወኅሩያን፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ ይትለሐዩ፡ ከመ፡ ብርሃነ፡ እሳት፡ ወአፉሆሙ፡ ይመልእ፡ በረከተ፡ ወከናፍሪሆሙ፡ ይሴብሑ፡ ስሞ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ወጽድቅ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ኢየኃልቅ፡ *ወርትዕ፡ ኢየኃልቅ፡ ቅድሜሁ።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: I saw a dwelling place beneath the wings of the Lord of Spirits. All the righteous and chosen shine[a] before him like the light of fire. Their mouth is filled with blessing, and their lips praise the name of the Lord of Spirits. Righteousness never comes to an end before him, and uprightness never comes to an end before him.[b]

footnotes.text: Dillmann’s 1865 lexicon, column33, gives the meanings “be adorned” and “shine” for this verb and cites this verse’s comparison with the light of fire. Charles’s apparatus records variant forms; this rendering follows his selected printed verb, not an inferred meaning from the simile alone.
The final uprightness clause is printed by Charles, but the apparatus records its omission in several manuscripts.

source.text: ህየ፡ ፈቀድኩ፡ አኅድር፡ ወፈተወት፡ መንፈስየ፡ ለውእቱ፡ ማኅደር፡ በህየ፡ ኮነ፡ ክፍለየ፡ ቅድመ፡ እስመ፡ ከመዝ፡ ጸንዐ፡ በእንቲአየ፡ በቅድመ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: There I wished to dwell, and my spirit longed for that dwelling place. My portion had been there from before,[a] for so it was established for me before the Lord of Spirits.

footnotes.text: The Ge’ez says, compactly, “there my portion was before.” It places Enoch’s portion there beforehand without specifying a more exact point in time.

source.text: በውእቱን፡ መዋዕል፡ ሰባሕኩ፡ ወአልዐልኩ፡ ስሞ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ በረከተ፡ ወስብሐተ፡ እስመ፡ ውእቱ፡ አጽንዐኒ፡ በበረከት፡ ወስብሐት፡ በከመ፡ ፈቃዱ፡ ለእግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: In those days I praised and exalted the name of the Lord of Spirits with blessing and praise, because he established me[a] in blessing and praise, according to the will of the Lord of Spirits.

footnotes.text: Or “strengthened me” or “made me firm.” The verb is related to “was established” in verse 8.

source.text: ወ*ጕንዳየ፡ ርእዩ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ በውእቱ፡ መካን፡ ወባረክዎ፡ ወሰባሕክዎ፡ እንዘ፡ እብል፤ ቡሩክ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወይትባረክ፡ እምቅድመ፡ ወእስከ፡ ለዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: For a long time my eyes looked at that place. I blessed him and praised him, saying, “Blessed is he, and may he be blessed from the beginning and forever.”

source.text: ወበቅድሜሁ፡ ማኅለቅት፡ አልቦ፤ ውእቱ፡ ያአምር፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ይትፈጠር፡ ዓለም፡ ምንት፡ ውእቱ፡ ለዓለም፡ ወለትውልደ፡ ትውልድ፡ ዘይከውን፡
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: There is no end before him. He knows, before the world was created, what is forever and what will be from generation to generation.

source.text: ይባርኩከ፡ እለ፡ ኢይነውሙ፡ ወይቀውሙ፡ ቅድመ፡ ስብሐቲ*ከ፡ ወይባርኩ፡ ወይሴብሑ፡ ወያሌዕሉ፡ እንዘ፡ ይብሉ፤ ቅዱስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ ቅዱስ፡ እግዚአ፡ መንፈሳት፡ ይመልእ፡ ምድረ፡ መንፈሳት።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: Those who do not sleep bless you. They stand before your glory and bless and praise and exalt, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Spirits; he fills the earth with spirits.”[a]

footnotes.text: The printed text says “spirits,” not “glory.” The wording is not harmonized to the similar praise in Isaiah 6:3.

source.text: ወበህየ፡ ርእያ፡ አዕይንትየ፡ ኵሎ፡ እለ፡ ኢይነውሙ፡ ይቀውሙ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ወይባርኩ፡ ወይብሉ፤ ቡሩክ፡ አንተ፡ ወቡሩክ፡ ስሙ፡ ለ*እግዚአ፡ *ለዓለመ፡ ዓለም።
source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: There my eyes saw all those who do not sleep standing before him. They bless him and say, “Blessed are you, and blessed is the name of the Lord forever and ever.”

source.note: Actual Charles1906 printed78-80 collated. Critical-edition marks retained; stars are apparatus flags, not automatically editorial supplies. The opening cross-chapter interpolation bracket before38:6 is disclosed in notes.

translation.text: My face changed, because I could not look.
